purpose: Fast causal prescreen of continuation after a controlled pause, selected to test immediate expansion rather than another reversal/fade family.

17BH_3BP_M1.source_disclosure: Open-source three-bar-play logic; related open-source research states the pattern is commonly used on 1m/2m/5m/10m charts.

signal.long: Bar1 bullish; Bar2 bearish with low above Bar1 low; Bar3 open and close above Bar2 open/close and Bar3 close above Bar2 high.
signal.short: Bar1 bearish; Bar2 bullish with high below Bar1 high; Bar3 open and close below Bar2 open/close and Bar3 close below Bar2 low.
signal.entry: first executable P75 tick at/after completed Bar3 right edge

17BI_IB_M15_BASE.source_disclosure: Open-source MQL5 Inside-Bar continuation EA; tested on XAUUSD and other markets on H1/M15.

signal.pattern: Signal Bar fully inside Main Bar; Main Bar close direction defines pending order direction.
signal.long_trigger: bullish Main Bar -> P75 Ask first crosses Main-Bar high after Signal-Bar completion
signal.short_trigger: bearish Main Bar -> P75 Bid first crosses Main-Bar low after Signal-Bar completion
signal.pending_expiry: one subsequent M15 bar; explicit project immediate-continuation adaptation
signal.filters: baseline: no optional ATR/body/inside-size quality filters
